name: Ledger::reconcile

test_list.description: A new error is appended as an open line with the injected timestamp.
An open issue absent from the stream becomes closed with a Closed timestamp.
A still-present issue is untouched, Opened time included.
Reconciling the same diagnostics twice changes nothing the second time.
Notes and headings between issue lines survive byte for byte and in place.
`aborting due to` and `could not compile` never open issues.
Warning diagnostics do not open issues.
A closed issue that returns gets a new open entry; the closed one stays.
Two diagnostics with the same message produce one ledger entry.
Id is #ERR- plus the first 16 hex digits of blake3 over the normalised message.
Spacing and line-break differences in a message keep the id.
Timestamps render as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ, sub-second part truncated.
A message containing ID:/Closed:/newline cannot forge ledger metadata.
A very long message is cut to the ledger text limit.
proptest: second reconcile with the same diagnostics is a no-op.
proptest: ids are equal iff normalised messages are equal.

output_description: Open issues plus counts of newly opened and newly closed.
